name: Adipose Offspring
oracle_text:
Emerge {5}{W} (You may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost reduced by that creature's mana value.)
When this creature enters, create a 2/2 white Alien creature token. If this creature's emerge cost was paid, instead create X of those tokens, where X is the sacrificed creature's toughness.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 white Alien creature token. If this creature's emerge cost was paid, instead create X of those tokens, where X is the sacrificed creature's toughness.

needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Alien token at all; the nearest 2/2 white creature tokens (cat_2_2_w, cat_beast_2_2_w) have the wrong creature type

needs.what: a condition reading whether this permanent's spell was cast for its emerge cost ("if this creature's emerge cost was paid"), and a value reading the toughness of the creature sacrificed to emerge (last-known toughness, since it is in the graveyard by the time the enters trigger resolves), usable on an enters trigger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `emerge` exists as a card-level cost and the cast action carries `emerge_oid`, but game.py only sacrifices that object and records nothing on the spell or permanent; condition_keys has `evoked`, `kicked`, `cost_option`, `was_cast` but no emerged flag, and value_keys has `toughness_had`/`toughness_of` only for bound objects, with no binding naming the emerge victim
